title: Reports: Broncos believe Pat Surtain II avoided long-term injury

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Reports: Broncos believe Pat Surtain II avoided long-term injury
sources.description: Broncos cornerback Pat Surtain II had to leave Sunday's 24-14 loss after the kind of non-contact injury that gives rise to thoughts of long-term absences, but early word is positive about Surtain's condition.
